about_the_game:
Expand your chances of survival and feel like a true zombie hunter! A new set of weapons and bonuses will help you hold the defense longer and crush hordes of the undead even more effectively.

🔥 Included in the DLC:

  • 💎 Unique Gabeman skin (Steam only!) — not available in the mobile version.

  • MP 412 — a powerful revolver for close combat.

  • Galil SAR — a legendary assault rifle, tested by time.

  • Winchester 1894 — an iconic rifle with the spirit of the Wild West.

  • RPG-7 — a heavy argument against hordes and bosses.

  • Tactical Knife — a fast and reliable way to finish off enemies.

  • M75 Hand Grenade — grenades capable of turning the tide of battle.

  • 50 crystals for upgrades and crafting.

  • 5 medkits for emergencies.

  • In the mobile version, this bundle would cost $4.99, but on Steam you get it for free.

❗️Just complete the tutorial — and get all exclusive content, including a unique skin, weapons, and survival bonuses!
